initialContact.message: I'm about to buy my first apartment! The bank approved my mortgage. I'm so excited but also overwhelmed. The real estate agent mentioned I need home insurance (kotivakuutus) before closing. What exactly do I need? The insurance company offered me like 5 different packages ranging from 15€ to 45€ per month. What's the difference and how much coverage do I actually need for a 55m² apartment?

problemContext.currentSituation: First-time home buyer needing to understand home insurance requirements before closing
problemContext.emotionalState: excited, overwhelmed, eager to do this right

idealAdvice: Home insurance (kotivakuutus) is MANDATORY with mortgage - bank requires it to protect their investment
Basic coverage should include: building damage (water, fire), personal property, liability
For 55m² apartment, mid-tier coverage (25-30€/month) is usually appropriate
Key factors: replacement value of belongings, deductible amount, coverage limits
Higher premium packages often include: electronics coverage, glass damage, all-risk coverage for valuables
As nurse with modest belongings, mid-tier likely sufficient - can upgrade later
Check if covers water damage (very common in Finnish apartments)
Liability coverage (vastuuvakuutus) essential - covers if you damage neighbor's apartment
Document your belongings with photos for potential claims
Review coverage annually, especially as you acquire more valuables
commonMistakes: Not explaining that mortgage lender requires insurance
Recommending cheapest option without explaining coverage gaps
Recommending most expensive without justifying need
Not explaining what different tiers actually cover
Failing to mention water damage coverage importance in Finland
Not congratulating her on major life milestone
